title: Scrum delivery
description: Sprint planning, inspection and follow-through for teams that use Scrum.

rules.instruction: Before selecting Sprint work, agree on a Sprint Goal and have the Developers check capacity and dependencies. Keep the Sprint Backlog current as they learn.
rules.verification: Check that each selected item supports the Sprint Goal or has a stated reason, that open dependencies have owners and that the team can explain the current plan.

rules.instruction: Apply the team's Definition of Done to the Increment. At the Sprint Review, gather stakeholder feedback and use it to revisit the Product Backlog.
rules.verification: Trace completed items to evidence for the Definition of Done and check that Review feedback has a recorded backlog decision.

rules.instruction: Choose an improvement from the Sprint Retrospective, give it an owner and agree on what to observe in the next Sprint.
rules.verification: At the next Retrospective, review the change and its observed effect before deciding whether to keep it.
